items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: I had Tommy Langley, again went back with me.

ctx.x: I had Tommy Langley, again went back with me. But, Doc Cheatham and Jerry Blake and Freddie Johnson. They were the only new men that I had. The rest of them were the old fellows that had been there before.
So, but we had just as good a band, in fact I think we had better material for a band. As you know from -- you listened to those records. The records we made in about '28 in Barcelona.
